name: SoChain
description: Get the balance, activity, counterparties and address poisoning findings of a BTC, LTC, DOGE or ZEC address from SoChain.
features: Accept a btc attribute (looked up on Bitcoin) or a coin-address object (looked up on the network of its symbol: BTC, LTC, DOGE or ZEC). Without a symbol, the network is the first on which SoChain says the address is valid.
Return a coin-address object with current-balance, total-received, total-sent, total-transactions, first-seen, last-seen and last-updated, referencing the input with related-to.
Return recent counterparties as coin-address objects linked with paid references whose comments give the amount, transaction and block: 5 on hover, 50 when the magnifying glass is clicked.
Return each look-alike address that sent the address dust (address poisoning) as a coin-address object that impersonates the address it copies.
No API key is needed for up to 2,500 lookups a day per IP. Each request has a 15-second timeout.

config.apikey: Optional. A SoChain API key from https://sochain.com/dashboard, sent as the API-KEY header.
